name: At-Tin · التين
en: By the fig and the olive

name: At-Tin · التين
en: And [by] Mount Sinai

name: At-Tin · التين
en: And [by] this secure city [Makkah]

name: At-Tin · التين
ar: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِيٓ أَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِيمٖ
en: We have certainly created man in the best of stature

name: At-Tin · التين
en: Then We return him to the lowest of the low

name: At-Tin · التين
ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونٖ
en: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted

name: At-Tin · التين
en: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense

name: At-Tin · التين
en: Is not Allah the most just of judges

name: Al-'Alaq · العلق
en: Recite in the name of your Lord who created

name: Al-'Alaq · العلق
en: Created man from a clinging substance

name: Al-'Alaq · العلق
en: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous

name: Al-'Alaq · العلق
en: Who taught by the pen

name: Al-'Alaq · العلق
en: Taught man that which he knew not

name: Al-'Alaq · العلق
en: No! [But] indeed, man transgresses

name: Al-'Alaq · العلق
en: Because he sees himself self-sufficient

name: Al-'Alaq · العلق
en: Indeed, to your Lord is the return

name: Al-'Alaq · العلق
en: Have you seen the one who forbids

name: Al-'Alaq · العلق
en: A servant when he prays

name: Al-'Alaq · العلق
en: Have you seen if he is upon guidance

name: Al-'Alaq · العلق
en: Or enjoins righteousness

name: Al-'Alaq · العلق
en: Have you seen if he denies and turns away

name: Al-'Alaq · العلق
en: Does he not know that Allah sees

name: Al-'Alaq · العلق
ar: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمۡ يَنتَهِ لَنَسۡفَعَۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
en: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock

name: Al-'Alaq · العلق
en: A lying, sinning forelock

name: Al-'Alaq · العلق
en: Then let him call his associates

name: Al-'Alaq · العلق
en: We will call the angels of Hell

name: Al-'Alaq · العلق
en: No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allah]
